name: lwr
description: A token-policy layer that makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. Ships one walking-skeleton rule, budget_line: PreToolUse on the Agent tool is denied unless the dispatch prompt carries a line matching '^BUDGET:\s*\d+k'. Policy is per-rule off/warn/deny, fails open (a missing or broken policy file never blocks a dispatch), and the engine is pure — see core/lwr_core/engine.py.
